title: Correct blue distance formula
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the expression $h_{blue} = h_{red} \sqrt{\frac{n_{red}^2 - 1}{n_{blue}^2 - 1}}$ for part (1).

title: Correct relative position
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that the blue light source is above the red light source for part (2).

title: Applies critical angle condition
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Snell's law to derive the critical angle condition $\sin C = 1/n$ for each color.

title: Relates geometry to critical angle
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning must correctly relate the critical angle to the geometry, setting $\sin C = h / \sqrt{R^2 + h^2}$.

title: Compares refractive indices
description: Important Criteria: The solution must note that $n_{blue} > n_{red}$ for visible light and use this to compare $h_{blue}$ and $h_{red}$.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional Criteria: The work should show clear algebraic steps to solve for $h_{blue}$ from the two critical angle equations.

title: Sign or inequality error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the final comparison of positions (above/below) is reversed or if an incorrect inequality is derived from the formula.

title: Misapplies critical angle
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the critical angle condition is written incorrectly, e.g., using $\sin C = n$ instead of $1/n$.
